caption: The drawing consists of two woven textile designs, each depicted as colored rectangles on an off-white background. The larger rectangle at the top is divided into vertical bands, each featuring repeating motifs in red, blue, and purple colors. The left side displays alternating red and purple vertical strips with stylized architectural forms such as houses and buildings, as well as abstract floral patterns. The center band is primarily blue and features a large ornate vase with symmetrical floral arrangements and curling leaves, accompanied by two birds facing the vase. The lower part of this band shows additional architectural and foliage motifs. The right section continues the use of blue and purple floral elements, echoing the designs seen on the left. Beneath this main design, there is a smaller rectangular detail that shows a close-up of the architectural motif, presenting structures with windows, roofs, and what appear to be turrets in red, blue, and purple threads, giving a finer view of the textile's woven texture. Below the designs, the text "BYRON A. DINSKAY, Allison Park, Pa." is printed on the left side. The composition is focused on symmetry, repetition, and a contrast between geometric architectural forms and organic floral patterns.
title: Coverlet: Boston Town
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
